{{nihongo|'''Nagahama Shrine'''|長濱神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

=== Overview ===
It stands on nearby high ground at the north end of the Nagahama district, on the northwestern foothills of {{ill|Mount Hottanjō|Q11579067|qid=Q11579067}}, overlooking {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Mito Sea Paradise}} from the south along the central coast of Uchiura Bay.

Its date of foundation is unknown, but it is identified with the same-named {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, '''Nagahama Shrine''' (ながはまじんじゃ), and is an old shrine also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkai-chō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Senior Fourth Rank Upper Grade, Nagase no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/nagahama_title.htm 長濱神社] - Genshōshi</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140206-01.html 長浜神社] - Research on Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

In the Edo period it was called "{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shinmei-sha}}," but in {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 3 ({{ill|1870|Q7741|qid=Q7741}}) it restored the name Nagahama Shrine<ref name="gen"/><ref name="engi"/>.

There is a theory that this shrine is a branch of the shikinaisha {{ill|Awa-no-Mikoto Shrine|Q17218974|qid=Q17218974}}, which stands in front of Nagahama on the northwestern coast of {{ill|Kōzu-shima|ar|كوزوشيما|arz|كوزوشيما|ceb|Kōzu Shima|cs|Kózušima|de|Kōzu-shima|es|Kōzushima|fa|کوزوشیما|fr|Kōzu-shima|ja|神津島|ko|고즈섬|pnb|کوزو-شیما|sk|Kozušima|sv|Kōzu-shima|tr|Kōzu-shima|uk|Острів Кодзу|zh|神津島|qid=Q301669}} in the {{ill|Izu Islands|Q864302|qid=Q864302}}. In line with that theory, Awanome-no-Mikoto, the enshrined deity there and the principal consort of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611}} ({{ill|Mishima Taisha|el|Μισίμα Τάισα|fr|Mishima-taisha|ja|三嶋大社|tr|Mishima Tapınağı|zh|三嶋大社|qid=Q650772|lt=Mishima Daimyōjin}}), is likewise the enshrined deity here<ref name="gen"/><ref name="engi"/>.

In Meiji 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), it was ranked as a village shrine<ref name="engi"/>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Awanome-no-Mikoto (あわのめのみこと)
